SILENTNEXUS.ConfigUrlDica: The address of Silent's bridge on this PC. See Silent → Options → Foundry.
SILENTNEXUS.ConfigTokenDica: Copy it from Silent → Options → Foundry. Without it, Silent refuses the connection.
SILENTNEXUS.DicaConexao: Check that Silent is open with the Foundry bridge turned on (Options → Foundry), and that the address and token in this module's settings match the ones there.
SILENTNEXUS.Vazio: Nothing here. Try the "All files" filter.
SILENTNEXUS.TemImagem: Has an image with the same name: it becomes the portrait and token
SILENTNEXUS.JaImportado: Already in Foundry: importing again updates the same actor
SILENTNEXUS.Forcar: Generate again with the AI (ignore what was already generated for this file)
SILENTNEXUS.NadaMarcado: Check at least one file in the list.
SILENTNEXUS.FichasProntas: {total} NPC sheet(s) ready in the Silent Nexus folder.
SILENTNEXUS.LojasProntas: {total} shop(s) ready in the Silent Nexus folder.
